He claims it’s from a botched surgery. Somehow he’s been granted FMLA. There are plenty of other days though when he’s walking around just fine, even talking walks in the park across from our office or standing around at a coworker’s desk laughing while they talk. I said laughed and said “That’s why you’re stumbling around?” He replied “This is the outside. I hope you get to feel what I feel, asshole.” Then he shuffled away with his cane and next thing I know I’m getting talked to by our boss about how I’m treating Mr. Pain and that it’s inappropriate. When I told my boss I knew he was faking, he told me “his doctors know more than you” and that if I ever voiced doubt about the coworker in the office again, I’d be looking for a new job.
